svg.aria-label: A plain repository called my-project goes into the Nabu box after typing /nabu:setup, and comes out with CONTRIBUTING.md, a PR template, a PR rules workflow, a release workflow, a protected main branch and a v1.0.0 release, while contributors send pull requests into it.

A plain repository called my-project goes into the Nabu box after typing /nabu:setup, and comes out with CONTRIBUTING.md, a PR template, a PR rules workflow, a release workflow, a protected main branch and a v1.0.0 release, while contributors send pull requests into it.

text.tspan: An agent skill that gives any GitHub repo branch
rules, a PR format, checks and automatic releases.
